proposed_comments.title: Keep Game Mode detection out of WH_MOUSE_LL
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep Game Mode detection out of `WH_MOUSE_LL`

**Severity:** `high`

`MouseHookProc` calls `detect_game_mode()` here, and that helper directly invokes `SHQueryUserNotificationState`. This shell query now runs in the system-wide low-level mouse-hook callback, where delays can stall mouse input or cause Windows to stop delivering the hook.

Refresh Game Mode state outside the hook and have the callback read only a cached result. Verify with a fullscreen D3D application that wrapping is suppressed while Game Mode is active without delaying ordinary mouse input.

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream head performs SHQueryUserNotificationState through detect_game_mode at lines 721-729 of the low-level hook.
